The ratio of the production of scooters by factory P to that by factory T in 1985 is:
solution:
**Given:**

Production of scooters by factory P in 1985 = 20 thousand

Production of scooters by factory T in 1985 = 40 thousand

**Formula used:**

Ratio = Production by factory P / Production by factory T

**Calculation:**

Ratio = 20 / 40

⇒ Ratio = 1 ∶ 2

**∴ The ratio of the production of scooters by factory P to that by factory T in 1985 is 1 ∶ 2.**
